name: Projekt Moon: Hope Awakens
source:
Projekt Moon: Hope Awakens is a zany sci-fi romp in which you will decide the fate of others, even empires, and impregnate. Impregnate queens in need of heirs, a subservient and adorable dark elf, and cat girls. Maybe a succubus and more! After you are given a DNA resequencing procedure and tortured, you have 2 distinct paths before you. Should you take the twisted chance at a new life and positively run with it? Or do you choose anger and wreak vengeance upon all who look at you in a way you dislike? The choice is yours. Choose wisely.

[From [url=https://themagicalgurl.itch.io/projekt-moon]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Projekt Moon: Hope Awakens》是一场疯狂的科幻冒险。你将决定他人的命运，甚至帝国的命运，并让人怀孕。让需要继承人的女王怀孕，让顺从可爱的黑暗精灵怀孕，还有猫娘。也许，还有魅魔与更多人！经历DNA重组手术与折磨之后，面前出现了两条截然不同的道路。你会抓住这个扭曲的新生机会，积极走下去？还是选择愤怒，向所有用你不喜欢的眼神看待你的人复仇？选择权在你。请明智决定。

[摘自[url=https://themagicalgurl.itch.io/projekt-moon]itch.io[/url]]
